course.title: Rural Development Planning-I
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: In the hypothetical situation of simple bid rent theory, consider there are 318 (15) households. Among them there are 26 doctors, and 292 other commuters of which 80 walk and 212 drive. Calculate and draw the bid rent curve of each group. Assume necessary data for each group.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2015
